verdict.rationale: Stripe's docs explicitly instruct AI coding agents to install the Stripe CLI and run `stripe sandbox create --help` to provision an anonymous sandbox with working API keys and no account registration, directly enabling agent-driven testing without touching production data. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation that the sandbox fully isolates agentic-commerce flows (SPTs, MCP, machine payments) from production, and more detail on sandbox data lifecycle/reset guarantees.
